properties.answer: A new part of its own, under Time & History. Anthony chose a new component `cmp:manual-work` for `crates/reflow2-core/src/manual_work.rs` over crediting the function to `cmp:temporal` next door, over `cmp:tools-temporal` where the tools are declared, and over filing it by purpose under `sub:session-posture`. Recorded as an ALLOCATED_TO edge, a CONTAINS from `sys:time-history`, and a REALIZES from `art:manual-work`; `chg:the-last-two-unallocated-capabilities-get-owners` carries the reasoning.
